name: Columbia consumer dry cell
description: National Carbon marketed a portable sealed dry cell for consumer electrical uses.

impact.note: A marketed sealed version of the existing dry cell; made portable power convenient in one market and led to flashlight and consumer battery lines.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: National Carbon marketed the Columbia dry cell in 1896.

evidence.locator: Production of the Columbia Dry Cell Battery
evidence.supports: The ACS identifies National Carbon as marketing the Columbia dry cell in 1896 and reports its nominal 1.5 volts. Earlier European dry-cell developments preceded it.

events.caveats: Marketing is evidence of an offer, not a measured quantity sold or universal access.
